conclusions.text: All 34461 original cells / 9065 intervals / 90 owners are accounted. Genuine source-relative authority supports 30621; 3840 originals remain explicitly held. Complete source, physical, semantic and historical evidence is preserved.

Specific identity holds, all territorial conflicts, original whole-source/physical/semantic questions, the 214/215 feature-count discrepancy, contemporary jurisdiction and selected/emitted delivery remain unresolved or pending.

limits: Exact original scope is 34461 cells / 9065 intervals / 90 owners (32510 land and 1951 inland-water). Genuine native authority supports 30621; 3840 originals remain held. The separate physical-interpretation companion is excluded from repair credit.

Complete Estonia ADM1/ADM2 products contain 15/214 unique features and 1452009 decoded bytes. The provider advertises 215 ADM2 units; this is a real disclosed discrepancy, not a completeness expectation. Complete catalogue-authenticated consumed bodies remain authoritative for literal source identity; no additional feature is invented. Recorded 2016/2017 dates, source updates/builds, OSM/Wambacher provenance, explicit CRS84 and ODbL 1.0 notices remain distinct.

All 90 direct municipal source units, complete parent chains and all current Europe semantic followups are retained. The original stage context selector read the unrelated Oceania decision file; the separate complete Europe interpretation corrects that context without altering or relabeling the frozen stage execution or source geometry. The future stage method now selects Europe.

Complete current ancestry rederives all original roster ownership, including 7136 ownerless originals and 7121 foreign ownerless features. Counts are measured from the authenticated complete 368-product / 73567-feature catalogue and roster. Exact original census intervals contain no foreign-original feature contacts. Complete country and 4596-feature ADM1 sources identify the same 1168 contrary keys (Russia 618, Latvia 550); all are held.

All nine contrary Natural Earth records remain whole. Before the original diagnostic, the preparation proves 767 of 810 repeated operands disjoint from closed envelopes containing each complete source, complete selected geometry and every requested native centre. Forty-three whole operands survive. A separate complete-original authentication verifies every negative against full country/ADM1 records and every envelope/mask. This changes neither coverage nor geometry and certifies no sovereignty.

All 90 whole-source physical results and 80 issue geometries remain. Independent applicability confirms every original native point has its declared physical class and zero contacts with all retained issues. This does not prove whole-polygon numeric closure, positional fitness or current dry land. The GSHHG LICENSE says LGPL v3-or-later while README says v3-or-earlier; both complete notices remain and the wording conflict is unresolved.

All 95173 historical candidates and complete routing rows are reconstructed before screening; 122 overlapping candidates cover 17264 original keys. Whole-candidate unknowns remain. Source tags neither omit spatial competitors nor establish acceptance or present historical affiliation.

Three specific original owner scopes remain held: Maidla 45 cells, Kaarma 1101, and Laane-Saare 1526. Full official 2013/2014 legal records contradict their represented 2017 municipal identities or named merged footprint. Laane-Saare is wholly disjoint from the source Kaarma territory despite the merger definition including Kaarma. No affirmative atlas intent resolves the conflict. These 2672 keys are disjoint from the 1168 territorial holds. Other 2016/2017 dates alone are not a blanket refusal.

The original whole-scope authority attempt correctly refused without output. The explicit genuine diagnostic then reports 33293 supported and 1168 held. Stock supported-input narrowing removes the exact additional identity holds and retains every surviving noncoverage source/physical/negative field. Its pinned reviewed helper provenance remains explicit; preparation approval is not delivery acceptance.

No selected ownership, cumulative ledger, emitted raster, regional certificate, deployment or accepted repair credit changes in this handoff. Genuine stock authority is source-relative and still requires current selected owner-zero, overlap and emitted conservation checks at delivery.

Nine custom evidence writers have eighteen occupied/dangling-output refusals. Coherently refreshed altered base geometry, missing retained negative, empty proof and changed owner all fail the complete-negative verifier without output. Exact Git bodies/counts/hashes and actual resource observations remain; no arbitrary custom file/phase/time ceiling is imposed.
